dialog.title: Close {number}
dialog.body: Closing makes the work order final. Planned against actual below: a figure beyond the tolerance needs a reason.
dialog.toleranceHint: Each figure may differ from the planned one by ±{tolerance} %; scrap counts against the planned garments (no scrap allowance is kept yet).
dialog.noCost: Material cost needs the cost grain (money.cost): whether it is beyond the tolerance still shows.
dialog.reasonHint: Why the work order ended outside the tolerance.
dialog.noReason: Within the ±{tolerance} % tolerance: no reason is needed.
dialog.undoHint: After the close, Undo stays on screen for a few seconds.

settle.title: Closing settles its cost
settle.body: The variance split and the closing entry are written now; after them the work order's cost takes only reversals.
settle.toPost_one: {count} cost entry not posted yet is posted first.
settle.toPost_other: {count} cost entries not posted yet are posted first.
settle.waitingTitle: The close waits for what is not costed yet

waits.title: Waits for the accountant
waits.close: The close is a status today: its variance split and closing entry are written only once the company's figures for the accountant are on. A work order closed now is settled by reopening it and closing it again then.
waits.preview: Closing now writes no split: this is what the close would write once the company's figures for the accountant are on.
waits.closed: It was closed as a status while the company's figures for the accountant were off: nothing was split. To settle it, reopen it and close it again once they are on.
waits.ppv: Purchase price variance is posted only once the company's figures for the accountant are on: receipts and invoices of this period wait until then.

reason.LEATHER_YIELD: The hides gave a different yield
reason.MATERIAL_PRICE: The material cost more or less than its standard
reason.REWORK: Rework took extra material or time
reason.METHOD_CHANGED: The garment was made another way
reason.STANDARD_OUT_OF_DATE: The standard is out of date
reason.NO_STANDARD: No standard to compare with yet

held.notCompleted: Only a completed work order is closed.
held.noManage: Closing a work order needs the permission {permission}.
held.costsWaiting_one: {count} event still waits to be costed: the close settles the cost, so it waits for it.
held.costsWaiting_other: {count} events still wait to be costed: the close settles the cost, so it waits for them.
held.reasonNeeded: A figure is beyond the ±{tolerance} % tolerance: choose a reason.
held.noteLong: The note is longer than {max} characters.
held.noRecord: Closed before the close was recorded: it is not reopened.
held.noReopen: Reopening a work order needs the permission {permission}.

reopen.title: Reopen {number}
reopen.body: Reopening takes the close back: the work order is completed again, and its cost takes entries again. Close it again when it is right.
reopen.bodySettled: Reopening takes the close back: its variance and closing entries are reversed (dated today) and the work order is completed again. Close it again when it is right.
reopen.reasonHint: Kept with the close; up to {max} characters.
reopen.reasonShort: Say why in at least {min} characters.
reopen.reasonLong: The reason is longer than {max} characters.

undo.settled: {number} is closed and its cost settled.
undo.body: Closed by mistake? Undo puts it back to completed.

closed.failed: Closed: who closed it could not be read.
closed.noRecord: Closed before the close was recorded.
closed.settled: Closed on {date} at {time} by {name}; its cost settled.
closed.status: Closed on {date} at {time} by {name}; closed as a status (its cost waits for the accountant).
closed.final: A closed work order is final: to change it, reopen it with a reason.

refusal.NOT_COMPLETED: Refused: only a completed work order is closed.
refusal.REASON_NEEDED: Refused: a figure is beyond the tolerance, so a reason is needed.
refusal.REASON_NOT_NEEDED: Refused: the figures are within the tolerance now, so no reason is taken. Read again and close.
refusal.NOTE_NEEDED: Refused: say the reason in words.
refusal.COSTS_WAITING: Refused: something still waits to be costed, and the close settles the cost.
refusal.LOCKED: Refused: today is in a locked period, so the cost cannot be settled today.
refusal.NOT_CLOSED: Refused: the work order is not closed.
refusal.NO_CLOSE_RECORD: Refused: it was closed before the close was recorded, so it is not reopened.
refusal.UNDO_TOO_LATE: Too late to undo: reopen it with a reason instead.
refusal.NOT_THE_CLOSER: Only the person who closed it may undo it: reopen it with a reason instead.
refusal.DATABASE: Refused by the cost checks: the cost could not be settled as it stands.
refusal.other: Refused: the work order's state does not allow it.

problem.changed: Someone changed the work order meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this here.
problem.not_found: Not found, or it belongs to another company.
problem.unavailable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment, then try again.
problem.invalid: The request was refused as not valid.
problem.conflict: Refused: the work order changed meanwhile.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

notice.closedSettled: {number} is closed and its cost settled.
notice.undone: The close is taken back: {number} is completed again.
notice.reopened: {number} is reopened: it is completed again.

variance.title: Variance at close
variance.notYet: The variance is taken at the close: once every garment is done and the work order is completed, closing it splits what is left on its cost.
variance.failed: Couldn't load the variance at close
variance.previewBody: What the close would write if it were closed now, against the standard of the garments made.
variance.noLines: Nothing to split: the work order's cost matches the standard of the garments made.
variance.noBasis: No frozen standard for every garment and no complete estimate at release: nothing is split, and the closing entry takes off everything left.
variance.entries_one: {count} entry written to the cost ledger.
variance.entries_other: {count} entries written to the cost ledger.
variance.unverified: The categories and what the closing entry takes are the build's reading until the accountant confirms them.

notSplit.NOT_ON_LEDGER: Rework is not split: rework time is not costed on the work order (its labour comes from the floor's scans).
notSplit.NO_SET_UP: Lot size is not split: neither the standard nor the work order carries a set-up time to spread over a lot.
notSplit.NO_BASIS: Nothing is split: no frozen standard for every garment and no complete estimate at release.

history.title: Closes taken back
history.undoneWhy: Undone within a few seconds of the close

ppv.title: Purchase price variance
ppv.hint: Purchase price against standard at the receipt or the invoice, posted {from} – {to}.

empty.title: No receipts in this period
empty.body: No purchase price variance was posted in {month}: a variance appears when a material is received or invoiced at a price other than its standard.

ppv.noCost: Standard, paid and difference are shown only to roles with the cost grain (money.cost).
